parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required. A UUID v4 that identifies this cancel request. Send the same key with the same body to retry safely: Ottu replays the first response. Send the same key with a different body and the call fails with `409` (`code: idempotency_conflict`).

parameters.name: subscription_id
parameters.description: AutoPay subscription identifier returned by subscription creation.
